in_marathi.name: Jhutan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jhutan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jhutan is derived from the Sanskrit root 'jhuh' meaning 'to grow' or 'expand'. This name is often given to a child who is expected to grow and flourish in all aspects of life.
